_doc: This instance's own settings (Pierre, 2026-11-13, Q339: the instance's central location made generic, should other organisations get instances of their own). centre: the place the instance is about, the centre of its "near" area: presence near it (tools/presence.py NEAR_AREA, rule C8) and the default covers (a node's leaf most seen around it: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Fish content"); lat and lon in degrees, radiusKm the area's radius. Written into fish.json centre by tools/build_fish.py (every mode). Another organisation's instance sets its own; the tools that still hard-wire Dauin's area: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "The instance's centre".
